name: Two-Speed Trend
plain_words: The live book with its 150-day line replaced by two lines: a 20-day and a 250-day. Half a position when one says up, full when both do, none when neither. Gold stays always held. Same weights, vol targets, costs and rails as the money desk.
baseline: live book: SMA150, 40/20/40, vol targets 15/40/15, weekly sizing, disaster stop -15% (recon.py variant E)
expectation: Fails on turnover — the 20-day line flips far more often than the 150-day; Sharpe about the same, costs higher. Expected FAIL.
